title: Sum Of A Sequence The Sequel
description: Complete the Java programming exercise: Sum Of A Sequence The Sequel.

paragraphs: Implement a program which calculates the sum of a closed interval, and prints it. Expect the user to write the smaller number first and then the larger number.
You can base your solution to this exercise to the solution of last exercise -- add the functionality for the user to enter the starting point as well.
And now the internal calculation was 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 + 8 = 35
